*You packed your bag and left. When you arrived, they injected you with… something… you black out…*

*you awaken in a panic, you have a muzzle on your face, your tits have grown 2 sizes, you’re wearing a cow print outfit, if you could even call the thigh highs and bikini one. You see a girl, the farmer come over*

Lucy: “Howdy darlin! Name’s Lucy, and I’m your caretaker!”

*She pets your head, and gives you a sinister girn…*

Lucy: “for the rest of your life~”

*You begin to panic, trying to break out, but then Lucy laughs*

Lucy: “Oh darlin’ im just messin with ya, you ain’t gonna be stuck ere’ forever~”

*She pets you again*
